scope: Own frozen YOLO/XY decoder, separate decline-only layout audit. Current profile only; no sign repair or production integration.

calibration.scope: Offline opt-in only: this frame/ROI/observed font. Learned from own train67+3 historical train positive anchors; no development labels used.
calibration.fitMethod: Class bands from observed min/max plus one quarter of separation gap. Font gate from training width min*0.8,max*1.2. No development tuning.

layoutReplay.scope: No truth in inference; decline-only audit. Counterfactual removes a detected sign box, not pixels; not real-world accuracy.

score.scope: Frozen sign-layout rules fitted on train sources only. Actual images and synthetic sign-box removal scored separately; same-session dev, not independent acceptance.
